alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left and gives itself a quick pat, left and right, then a speech bubble says phone and its eyes turn happy. It pats again, bubble: keys. Again, bubble: wallet. After the third check it pulses and walks forward, ready to go, then narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me patting my pockets before I leave.
